_source: Each entry is a claim our profile (gdl/designsys/mach.json) or its README made that Mach's own pages contradict, found by the grammar measurement of 2026-10-22: every page and popup of seeds/Mach 1035.gdl, 725, 720, 1525, 1535, 525, 535 and 320, read with gdl.project (each control's rect, look, caption and font) beside its renders. `template` is what those pages do, off the seed and pages named; the region frame (panels[series].frame) is the same seeds measured by tests/measure_series.py frame_of. `python -m gdl.designsys audit mach` checks every resolution against the profile, the README and the frame as they stand.

entries.claim: README Visual foundations: at least 12 px between touchable controls, no more than nine buttons in one group, place things on GUI Designer's 10 px nudge.

template.does: The template butts controls 1 px apart - its header tabs on every series, a rail group's buttons on the 1035, 1525 and 1535, where the 725's step 10 px apart and the 720's 8 - has groups of 12 (Window Layout) and 40 (the keyboard), and places at 17, 149, 186, 247, 258, 449, 1069 and the like, off the 10 px grid.

entries.reason: The 2 mm gap the toolkit checks between touch targets and Extron's documented nine-button and spacing standards (docs/design-rules.md section 2), which a designer's own controls keep; the template's own joined sets are the owner's exception (2026-10-22), kept by the region components at the step the frame measures. The README now says the template does not always keep them.
entries.here: Your own controls keep 2 mm apart, nine to a group, on the 10 px nudge - Extron's Design Standards. The template's own sets stand as it draws them - its tabs 1 px apart, a rail group 1 px apart on the 1035, 1525 and 1535 and 10 and 8 on the 725 and 720 - and the region components draw them so.

fix.readme: Extron's Design Standards, which its own templates do not always keep

entries.evidence: Main SD's tabs and rail groups 1 px apart; Window Layout's twelve presets; VTC Keyboard's 40 keys. entries.claim: README: give feedback with states ... every state must look different.
